messages:
maria (support): Heads-up — multiple customers reporting the per-model throughput graphs in Console have been flatlined since ~03:10 UTC. Tickets linked: https://support.redwood.ai/t/2357 (customer-visible) and internal #2357-thread. Looks like every model series is zeroed out in the UI. Can SRE/ML take a look?

aj (sre): Looking now. Any recent metric/exporter deploys around 02:50–03:00?

kevin (eng-ml): We shipped a tiny change to metrics-exporter at 02:57 to rename the label from "model_name" -> "model" to standardize with the runtime. I can roll it back if that's the cause.

aj (sre): Confirmed on Prometheus: queries that group by model_name return no series. Grouping by (model) shows expected traffic. Example quick checks: 
```
# empty
sum(rate(inference_requests_total[5m])) by (model_name)
# returns nothing
\n# works
sum(rate(inference_requests_total[5m])) by (model)
# returns expected series (model=zebra-2, model=redwood-7b, ...)
```

aj (sre): So dashboards expecting label "model_name" find nothing now. That explains the flatline in per-model throughput panels (they were grouped by model_name).

kevin (eng-ml): Sorry — that rename went out without coordinating with observability. Short-term options: 1) revert exporter to restore model_name label, 2) update all Grafana panels/templating to use the new label, or 3) use a PromQL shim to synthesize model_name from model so dashboards keep showing continuity.

dana (product): We need impact statement for customers — how long to restore visible graphs, and whether any billing/metrics downstream are affected.

aj (sre): Billing pipelines unaffected (billing queries run on aggregated counters, not per-model panels). ETA for fixes: if we revert exporter -> ~30m (deploy + smoke). If we patch dashboards with a compatibility query -> can be done in ~1–2h (update panels, variables). Easiest immediate fix is to change panels to a compatibility query so we don't need a rollback.

kevin (eng-ml): I'll open PR to metrics-exporter to emit both labels (model and model_name) and mark model_name deprecated in the spec. That PR will also include a smoke test. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metrics-exporter/pull/128 (WIP).

aj (sre): For Grafana, here's a PromQL snippet to keep dashboard continuity without changing the exporter:
```
# synthesize model_name from model if missing
sum(rate(label_replace(inference_requests_total, "model_name", "$1", "model", "(.*)")[5m])) by (model_name)
```
This will let panels continue showing series keyed by model_name regardless of whether the exporter emitted it. I'll push that as a temporary change to the shared dashboard folder.

grafana-bot: Updated dashboard "Per-model throughput (Console)" with compatibility query (PR #542).

maria (support): Great. Can you confirm whether historical points (the missing 03:10–now) will be backfilled automatically if we do the exporter change? Customers asking if graphs will show the missing window.

aj (sre): Prometheus won't magically backfill old timestamps. If we reintroduce the label on new samples, the timeseries will resume and Grafana will show continuity forward from that point. To backfill the missing samples we'd need to replay raw request logs into a metrics ingest or run a synthetic job to emit historical points — both are heavier ops and not worth for a short window. Alternative: re-deploy exporter with both labels ASAP so customers see data resume; add a note in the ticket that historical gap won't be retroactively populated.

kevin (eng-ml): Agreed. Plan: (A) quick exporter patch to emit both labels and deploy (I own, target +30m), (B) SRE will merge the Grafana compatibility query so dashboards don't need a deploy for visibility (+15–30m), (C) we add a changelog/deprecation notice and schedule full removal in 3 months. I'll add unit tests to prevent label drops.

aj (sre): I'll also add an alert rule to catch label/name mismatches for key metrics (new runbook entry). Putting ops on watch for the deploy.

maria (support): I'll update all affected customer tickets and share the ETA (exporter patch + Grafana change). Will also include the note about no automatic backfill.

kevin (eng-ml): PR opened: metrics-exporter #128 (adds alias label model_name). Deploy in progress — tagging @aj for rollout.

aj (sre): Rolling patch now to staging; will promote to prod after smoke.

maria (support): Thanks team. I'll send a short customer-facing status update now. :thumbsup:
